author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: For every h >= 2, explicit symmetric and antisymmetric hook entries yield full partition-space shift rank at least 2h; a codebook containing the reference states and q hooks inherits rank at least 2q. The source lexicographic codebook has q >= floor(sqrt(h) log(h)/4) for all sufficiently large h. On energy E the all-ones label slice obeys Q_s=Q_-s and sum_s (s^2-4hE) Q_s=0, bounding its rank by 2h at E=h.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size argument
Determine full 4h rank for all h or locate further relations
Determine sharper actual codebook coverage and account for all recursive costs in any algorithmic proposal
